meta.title: Modpack Kit
meta.description: Who says DSH cannot do modpacks? (Put these plugins together and it is genuinely good.) Bundle DeepSeek Harness plugins with their config and data into one .dshpack: one-click install, works offline, three strategies, groups share the plugin market. npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-modpack-kit. Search integrates the market AI search.
